map.💡 续航时间 = 电池容量(Ah) × 电压(V) × 效率 × 放电深度 /: Tip: Runtime = battery capacity (Ah) x voltage (V) x efficiency x depth-of-discharge / power (W).
map.实际续航受温度、放电倍率、老化等影响，理论值为上限参考: Actual runtime is affected by temperature, discharge rate and aging; the theoretical value is an upper-bound reference
map.由容量、电压、效率、放电深度估算续航时间。: Estimate runtime from capacity, voltage, efficiency and depth of discharge.
map.对比不同电池方案可用电量。: Compare usable energy of different battery schemes.
map.选型避免中途断电。: Select to avoid mid-use power loss.
map.电池 5000mAh、3.7V、效率 85%、DoD 80%、负载 10W：理论: Battery 5000mAh, 3.7V, efficiency 85%, DoD 80%, load 10W: theoretical energy = 5x3.7 = 18.5Wh, usable = 18.5x0.85x0.8 = 12.58Wh, runtime T = 12.58/10 ~ 1.26h (about 1h 16min).
map.若 DoD 提到 100%：可用 = 18.5×0.85 = 15.7Wh，续航: If DoD raised to 100%: usable = 18.5x0.85 = 15.7Wh, runtime ~ 1.57h; but deep discharge harms battery life, generally control at 80%.
map.放电深度，可用电量占比；DoD 80% 表示只用 80% 容量，保留余量延长循环: Depth of discharge, the share of usable energy; DoD 80% means using only 80% capacity, reserving margin to extend cycle life; power batteries often limit 80-90%.
map.容量 Ah 和 Wh 什么关系？: What is the relation between Ah and Wh?
map.Wh = Ah×V，是能量而非电荷；同 Ah 下电压高则能量大、续航长，选型看: Wh = Ah x V, it is energy not charge; at the same Ah a higher voltage gives more energy and longer runtime, so look at Wh for selection.
